verdict.rationale: An on-device ML inference runtime is a fair axis for a game engine, so the story applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows PlayCanvas shipping an official inference runtime or any way to run ML models inside a game. The MCP server and PlayCanvas Skills serve AI-assisted authoring in the Editor, which is a different capability, and the WebGPU/WebAssembly mentions are rendering and physics features, not model execution.

support.subject: As a game developer, I can run ML models inside the game — an official inference runtime for on-device model execution
